title: Better Sampler Reactive 2
description: Reactive with a left sidebar of folding sections (Engine detail, Mod Sources, Filter, Mod Matrix, Voice / Out) beside a sample viewer as wide as Better Sampler's with the engine strip fixed under it, Ableton Wavetable-style Mod Sources (Envelopes & LFOs), Mod Matrix (Matrix / MIDI / MPE), and Dual Filter + Oscillator 2 / Sub.
